subject: HEALTH
title: Health 1
description: Health 1 teaches young children to understand and care for themselves and others: naming and managing feelings, kindness and conflict resolution, handwashing, tooth care and sleep, MyPlate food groups and healthy snacks, daily physical activity, the senses and major organs, and safety at home, at play and on the road. Students also learn medicine and poison safety and meet community health helpers.
framework: 2008 California Health Education Content Standards; 2019 CA Health Education Framework

standards.H-1.1.1.M: Identify a range of feelings and how they can be expressed in healthy ways.
standards.H-1.1.2.M: Describe ways to show caring, kindness, and respect for others, including people who are different.
standards.H-1.1.3.M: Recognize teasing and bullying behaviors and why they are harmful.
standards.H-1.4.1.M: Use 'I-messages' and listening skills to express needs and feelings and to ask a trusted adult for help.
standards.H-1.4.2.M: Demonstrate simple ways to resolve conflicts with friends and family.
standards.H-1.7.1.M: Practice healthy ways to calm down and manage strong feelings.
standards.H-1.1.1.P: Explain how germs spread and how handwashing and covering coughs prevent illness.
standards.H-1.1.2.P: Describe the importance of caring for teeth, including brushing, flossing, and dental checkups.
standards.H-1.1.3.P: Explain why sleep and rest are important for health.
standards.H-1.3.1.P: Identify health helpers in the community (doctor, nurse, dentist, pharmacist) and how they keep us healthy.
standards.H-1.7.1.P: Demonstrate proper handwashing, toothbrushing, and personal hygiene practices.
standards.H-1.8.1.P: Encourage others to practice healthy habits and to keep the environment clean (reduce, reuse, recycle).
standards.H-1.1.1.N: Classify foods into the food groups shown on MyPlate.
standards.H-1.1.2.N: Explain why the body needs a variety of healthy foods and water.
standards.H-1.1.3.N: Identify healthy snacks and the importance of eating breakfast.
standards.H-1.1.4.N: Describe the benefits of daily physical activity for the heart, muscles, and mood.
standards.H-1.2.1.N: Identify how family, friends, and advertising influence food choices.
standards.H-1.5.1.N: Use a simple decision-making process to choose healthy snacks and drinks.
standards.H-1.6.1.N: Set a short-term goal to eat more fruits and vegetables or be more physically active and track progress.
standards.H-1.7.1.N: Practice healthy eating and food-safety habits (washing hands and produce before eating).
standards.H-1.1.1.G: Identify the five senses and the body parts associated with them.
standards.H-1.1.2.G: Describe how people grow and change over time.
standards.H-1.1.3.G: Identify major body organs (heart, lungs, brain, stomach) and their basic jobs.
standards.H-1.1.1.S: Identify safe practices as a pedestrian, bike rider, and car passenger (crosswalks, helmets, car/booster seats, seat belts).
standards.H-1.1.2.S: Explain fire safety rules, including stop-drop-and-roll and a home escape plan.
standards.H-1.1.3.S: Distinguish safe and unsafe touch and situations, and identify trusted adults.
standards.H-1.1.4.S: Identify water, sun, and playground safety rules.
standards.H-1.4.1.S: Demonstrate how to call 911 and give your name and address in an emergency.
standards.H-1.7.1.S: Practice safety behaviors at home, at play, and on the road.
standards.H-1.1.1.A: Explain that medicines can help or harm and should be given only by trusted adults.
standards.H-1.1.2.A: Identify household products that are harmful if swallowed, touched, or inhaled, and the poison symbol.
standards.H-1.1.3.A: Explain that tobacco smoke and vaping are harmful to the body.
standards.H-1.4.1.A: Demonstrate saying 'no' and telling a trusted adult about unsafe substances.

units.title: My Feelings and My Friends
units.big_idea: All feelings are okay; how we express them and treat others matters.

units.title: Germs, Hygiene and Healthy Habits
units.big_idea: Clean hands, clean teeth and enough sleep keep our bodies healthy.

units.title: Food Groups and Healthy Eating
units.big_idea: Eating a variety of foods from every food group gives our bodies what they need.

units.title: Active Bodies
units.big_idea: Moving every day keeps our heart, muscles and minds strong.

units.title: My Amazing, Growing Body
units.big_idea: Our senses and organs work together, and we keep growing and changing.

units.title: Staying Safe
units.big_idea: Knowing safety rules and trusted adults helps us stay safe at home, at play and on the road.

units.title: Medicines and Harmful Substances
units.big_idea: Some things can help or harm our bodies; we ask trusted adults before touching or taking anything.

units.title: Health Helpers and a Healthy Community
units.big_idea: Many people help keep us healthy, and we can help others be healthy too.

objectives: Recognize feelings in faces and bodies
materials: 'The Way I Feel' by Janan Cain (library)

days.title: Feelings book
days.work: Read 'The Way I Feel' by Janan Cain and name the feeling on each page.

days.title: Mirror faces
days.work: Make happy, sad, angry, scared, surprised and proud faces in a mirror; draw two of them.

days.title: Body clues
days.work: Talk about where you feel feelings in your body (tight fists, butterflies in tummy).

days.title: Feelings check-in
days.work: Start a daily feelings chart: point to how you feel each morning and tell why.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Match 6 feeling words to face pictures and tell about a time you felt one.

objectives: Practice 3 healthy ways to calm down

days.title: Belly breathing
days.work: Practice 'smell the flower, blow out the candle' breathing with a pinwheel.

days.title: Calm-down jar
days.work: Make a glitter calm-down jar and watch the glitter settle while breathing.

days.title: Mindful moment
days.work: Do a GoNoodle Flow mindfulness video and tell how your body feels after.

days.title: Calm corner
days.work: Set up a calm corner at home with 3 tools (jar, pillow, feelings chart).

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Role-play a frustrating moment and use a calm-down strategy.

weeks.topic: Using I-messages and asking for help
materials: sentence frame card: 'I feel ___ when ___. I need ___.'

days.title: I-messages
days.work: Learn 'I feel ___ when ___. I need ___.' and practice with 3 example problems.

days.title: Listening
days.work: Practice good listening (eyes, ears, quiet body) while a family member shares.

days.title: Trusted adults hand
days.work: Trace your hand and write a trusted adult on each finger.

days.title: Ask for help
days.work: Role-play asking a trusted adult for help when lost, hurt or sad.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Use an I-message to solve a pretend problem.

weeks.assessment: I-message demonstration and trusted adults hand.

materials: 'Last Stop on Market Street' by Matt de la Peña (library)

days.title: Read
days.work: Read 'Last Stop on Market Street' and talk about how CJ learns to see beauty in others.

days.title: Same and different
days.work: List 3 ways you are the same as and 3 ways different from a friend.

days.title: Kindness challenge
days.work: Do one kind act each day and record it.

days.title: Include others
days.work: Role-play inviting someone new to play.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Make a 'kindness recipe' card with 4 ingredients.

objectives: Use steps to solve a conflict
materials: conflict-resolution steps poster (stop, talk, listen, solve)

days.title: Conflict steps
days.work: Learn stop, talk, listen, solve; act it out with stuffed animals.

days.title: Compromise
days.work: Practice taking turns or sharing to solve a toy conflict.

days.title: Teasing vs. bullying
days.work: Learn that bullying is mean on purpose and repeated; sort scenario cards.

days.title: Be an upstander
days.work: Role-play telling a bully 'Stop!' and getting a trusted adult.

days.title: Unit 1 check
days.work: Unit assessment: name feelings, show a calm-down tool, solve a conflict scenario.

days.title: Glitter germs
days.work: Put lotion and glitter on hands, shake hands with family and see how 'germs' spread.

days.title: Sneeze spray
days.work: Use a spray bottle to show how far a sneeze travels; practice the elbow sneeze.

days.title: Germ hideouts
days.work: Find places germs collect (doorknobs, phones) and wipe them with an adult.

days.title: Read
days.work: Read a KidsHealth article on germs together.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Explain 3 ways to stop germs (wash hands, sneeze into elbow, keep hands away from face) and show the elbow sneeze.

days.title: Pepper experiment
days.work: Sprinkle pepper on water and touch with a soapy finger to see germs 'run away'.

days.title: Six steps
days.work: Learn handwashing steps; sing 'Happy Birthday' twice while scrubbing.

days.title: When to wash
days.work: Make a poster of times to wash (before eating, after bathroom, after coughing).

days.title: Glow test
days.work: Rub on lotion with glitter, wash, and check how much is left to test your scrubbing.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Demonstrate all handwashing steps.

days.title: Egg teeth
days.work: Place a hard-boiled egg in cola overnight; brush the stain to see how brushing removes stains.

days.title: Brush right
days.work: Practice brushing in circles for 2 minutes on all surfaces with a timer.

days.title: Floss
days.work: Practice flossing with help; use a play-dough 'teeth' model.

days.title: Tooth-healthy foods
days.work: Sort foods into tooth-friendly and sticky/sugary.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Fill in a 1-week brushing chart and explain why we visit the dentist.

days.title: Why sleep?
days.work: Learn that 6-year-olds need about 9–12 hours of sleep and why.

days.title: Sleep log
days.work: Start a sleep log of bedtime and wake time for a week.

days.title: Bedtime routine
days.work: Make a picture chart for a calm bedtime routine.

days.title: Read
days.work: Read a bedtime-themed picture book and discuss rest.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Review sleep log and explain how you feel with good sleep.

objectives: Encourage others to practice healthy habits

days.title: Healthy habits poster
days.work: Make a poster encouraging handwashing for your bathroom.

days.title: Teach someone
days.work: Teach a younger sibling or friend handwashing steps.

days.title: Clean environment
days.work: Sort household recycling and talk about how clean places keep us healthy.

days.title: Habit tracker
days.work: Track handwashing, brushing and sleep for 5 days.

days.title: Unit 2 check
days.work: Unit assessment on germs, hygiene and sleep.

days.title: MyPlate
days.work: Look at MyPlate and name the 5 food groups and their colors.

days.title: Sort
days.work: Cut food pictures from grocery ads and sort them onto a paper-plate MyPlate.

days.title: Kitchen hunt
days.work: Find one food from each group in the kitchen.

days.title: Lunch check
days.work: Check today's lunch for food groups.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Sort 15 food cards into groups.

objectives: Explain why we eat a rainbow of fruits and vegetables
materials: fruits and vegetables of many colors

days.title: Taste test
days.work: Taste 4 fruits/vegetables of different colors and describe them.

days.title: Wash produce
days.work: Wash produce properly before eating.

days.title: Rainbow chart
days.work: Track eating red, orange, yellow, green and purple foods this week.

days.title: Read
days.work: Read 'Eating the Alphabet' by Lois Ehlert (library).

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Explain why we eat many colors.

days.title: Sugar in drinks
days.work: Count sugar cubes in soda vs. milk vs. water.

days.title: Breakfast power
days.work: Discuss why breakfast fuels the brain; plan a healthy breakfast.

days.title: Snack decisions
days.work: Use 'stop, think, choose' to pick between snack pairs.

days.title: Make a snack
days.work: Make an ants-on-a-log or fruit-and-yogurt snack.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Choose 3 healthy snacks and explain why.

objectives: Identify how family, friends and ads influence choices

days.title: Cereal boxes
days.work: Look at cereal boxes for cartoons and colors meant to attract kids.

days.title: Ad detective
days.work: Watch a kid's food commercial and discuss its tricks.

days.title: Family food
days.work: Interview a family member about favorite family foods and traditions.

days.title: Design a healthy ad
days.work: Make an ad for a fruit or vegetable.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Explain one influence on your food choices.

days.title: Clean hands, clean food
days.work: Wash hands and produce before cooking.

days.title: Cold and hot
days.work: Learn that some foods must stay cold in the fridge.

days.title: Cook together
days.work: Make a simple MyPlate meal (wrap or salad) with an adult.

days.title: Kitchen safety
days.work: Learn knife, stove and hot-pan safety rules.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Explain 3 kitchen safety rules.

objectives: Set and track a healthy eating goal

days.title: Set a goal
days.work: Choose a goal like 'eat a vegetable at every dinner.'

days.title: Track
days.work: Track the goal with stickers each day.

days.title: Plan a menu
days.work: Plan one day's meals using MyPlate.

days.title: Grocery list
days.work: Write a grocery list with foods from each group.

days.title: Unit 3 check
days.work: Food-group assessment (sort and label a MyPlate) and tell whether you met your eating goal.

days.title: Heart and lungs
days.work: Feel heartbeat and breathing before and after 1 minute of jumping.

days.title: Benefits
days.work: List how activity helps heart, muscles, bones and mood.

days.title: 60 minutes
days.work: Learn kids need 60 minutes of activity daily; brainstorm fun ways.

days.title: Activity log
days.work: Start a week-long activity log, drawing each active thing you do and how many minutes it lasted.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Explain 3 benefits of activity.

objectives: Balance screen time and active play

days.title: Screen time count
days.work: Count screen minutes for a day.

days.title: Active swaps
days.work: Make a list of active swaps for screen time.

days.title: Outdoor play
days.work: Play outside for 30 minutes with a family member.

days.title: Family challenge
days.work: Do a family walk after dinner.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Compare active and screen minutes.

objectives: Set and track an activity goal

days.title: Set goal
days.work: Choose a goal like 'play outside 30 minutes every day.'

days.title: Track
days.work: Color one box on your goal chart each day you meet the goal and note the activity you chose.

days.title: Try something new
days.work: Try a new activity (scooter, swimming, hopscotch).

days.title: Encourage
days.work: Invite a family member to join your goal.

days.title: Unit 4 check
days.work: Count your colored boxes, tell whether you met your activity goal, and name 3 benefits of moving every day.

objectives: Identify the five senses and body parts

days.title: Senses intro
days.work: Name the five senses and matching body parts.

days.title: Smell test
days.work: Guess spices by smell with eyes closed.

days.title: Touch box
days.work: Reach into a box and identify 6 hidden objects (sponge, spoon, pinecone) by touch, describing each texture.

days.title: Taste test
days.work: Taste sweet, salty, sour foods.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Label a body diagram with sense organs.

objectives: Identify heart, lungs, brain, stomach and their jobs

days.title: Body outline
days.work: Trace your body on butcher paper.

days.title: Add organs
days.work: Draw and label heart, lungs, brain and stomach.

days.title: Lung model
days.work: Make a lung model with a plastic bottle and balloons; pull the bottom balloon to see the lungs fill with air.

days.title: Brain boss
days.work: Learn the brain sends messages; play a reaction game.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Point to the heart, lungs, brain and stomach on your outline and tell each organ's job.

objectives: Describe how people grow and change

days.title: Baby photos
days.work: Compare baby photos and current photos.

days.title: Measure
days.work: Measure height and hand size and compare with family.

days.title: Timeline
days.work: Make a life timeline: baby, toddler, now, grown-up.

days.title: What I can do now
days.work: List things you can do now that you couldn't as a baby.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Explain 3 ways you have grown and changed since you were a baby, using your timeline.

days.title: Body care
days.work: Add healthy habits around your body outline.

days.title: Protecting senses
days.work: Discuss protecting eyes (sunglasses) and ears (not too loud).

days.title: Growth foods
days.work: Connect protein and dairy to growing.

days.title: Share
days.work: Present your body outline to family, naming senses, organs and the habits that keep them healthy.

days.title: Unit 5 check
days.work: Assessment: label 5 sense organs and 4 inner organs and describe one way bodies grow.

objectives: Practice crossing streets and car safety

days.title: Crossing streets
days.work: Practice stop, look left-right-left, listen, and hold an adult's hand.

days.title: Traffic signs
days.work: Learn walk/don't walk signals and stop signs.

days.title: Car safety
days.work: Practice buckling into a booster seat correctly.

days.title: Neighborhood walk
days.work: Walk with an adult and use crosswalks.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Demonstrate safe crossing steps.

days.title: Helmet fit
days.work: Practice the 2-V-1 helmet fit test.

days.title: Egg helmet
days.work: Drop an egg with and without a foam 'helmet' to see protection.

days.title: Bike ride
days.work: Ride with helmet in a safe area.

days.title: Playground rules
days.work: Make a list of playground safety rules and practice at a park.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Put on your helmet alone and pass the 2-V-1 fit check; name 2 playground rules.

days.title: Smoke alarms
days.work: Listen to the smoke alarm test and learn what to do.

days.title: Stop, drop, roll
days.work: Practice stop, drop (cover face) and roll, and crawling low under 'smoke' (a held-up blanket).

days.title: Escape plan
days.work: Draw a home floor plan with two exits from each room and a meeting place.

days.title: Fire drill
days.work: Hold a family fire drill at the sound of the alarm and time how fast everyone reaches the meeting place.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Explain the escape plan: two ways out of your bedroom, where to meet, and never go back inside.

objectives: Call 911 and give name and address

days.title: What is an emergency?
days.work: Sort situations into emergency and not.

days.title: Learn address
days.work: Memorize home address and a parent's phone number.

days.title: Pretend call
days.work: Practice a pretend 911 call with a toy phone.

days.title: First aid
days.work: Learn to tell an adult when someone is hurt.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Recite address and role-play a 911 call.

weeks.topic: Safe and unsafe touch; trusted adults
objectives: Distinguish safe and unsafe touch and situations

days.title: Safe touch
days.work: Discuss safe touches (hugs from family, high fives) and unsafe touches.

days.title: No, go, tell
days.work: Practice the 'No, Go, Tell' rule.

days.title: Strangers
days.work: Discuss what to do if a stranger offers a ride or treat.

days.title: Body ownership
days.work: Discuss that your body belongs to you and secrets about touching should be told.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Role-play 'No, Go, Tell' in 3 scenarios and name 3 trusted adults you would tell.

objectives: Follow water and sun safety rules

days.title: Sun paper
days.work: Place objects on construction paper in the sun to see fading and discuss sun protection.

days.title: Sunscreen
days.work: Practice applying sunscreen and wearing a hat.

days.title: Water rules
days.work: Learn swim with an adult, life jackets and no running by pools.

days.title: Safety book
days.work: Make a safety mini-book with one rule per page.

days.title: Unit 6 check
days.work: Safety assessment: sort safe/unsafe pictures and explain road, fire, 911, touch and sun rules.

days.title: What medicine does
days.work: Learn medicines can help when sick but only trusted adults give them.

days.title: Look-alikes
days.work: Compare pictures of candy and pills that look alike.

days.title: Labels
days.work: Look at a medicine label with an adult.

days.title: Role-play
days.work: Practice saying 'I need to ask my mom/dad first.'

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Explain who can give medicine.

objectives: Identify poison symbols and dangerous products

days.title: Poison symbols
days.work: Learn skull-and-crossbones and Mr. Yuk symbols.

days.title: Safety hunt
days.work: With an adult, find products under the sink with warning labels.

days.title: Safe storage
days.work: Help put dangerous products up high or locked.

days.title: Poison Control
days.work: Learn the Poison Control number (1-800-222-1222).

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Sort product cards into safe to touch and ask an adult.

objectives: Explain why smoke and vapes are harmful

days.title: Healthy lungs
days.work: Revisit the balloon lung model and discuss what smoke does.

days.title: Secondhand smoke
days.work: Learn that breathing others' smoke harms health.

days.title: Say no
days.work: Practice saying 'No thanks' and walking away.

days.title: Smoke-free poster
days.work: Make a smoke-free home poster.

days.title: Unit 7 check
days.work: Assessment: identify the poison symbol, explain who may give medicine, and model saying no to smoke.

days.title: Who helps?
days.work: Learn about doctors, nurses, dentists and pharmacists.

days.title: Checkup
days.work: Role-play a doctor checkup with a toy kit.

days.title: Interview
days.work: Interview a health helper (family doctor, nurse) about their job.

days.title: Map
days.work: Find clinics, pharmacies and hospitals on a community map.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Match 6 health helpers to their jobs and tell which one you would visit for a toothache.

days.title: Clean-up
days.work: Do a family neighborhood or park clean-up.

days.title: Healthy messages
days.work: Make a healthy-habits card for a neighbor.

days.title: Share
days.work: Share a healthy snack with friends.

days.title: Kind words
days.work: Encourage a friend who is learning something new.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Explain how you helped your community.

days.title: Review habits
days.work: Review trackers from the year.

days.title: Choose goals
days.work: Choose a summer health goal in eating, activity and hygiene.

days.title: Plan
days.work: Write or draw 2 steps for each goal (e.g., keep a water bottle in the fridge to drink more water).

days.title: Share
days.work: Share your goals with family and ask one person to be your goal buddy.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Explain one goal, its steps and how you will track it over the summer.

days.title: Review game
days.work: Play a health Jeopardy game with family.

days.title: Health journal
days.work: Make a 'My Healthy Me' book with one page each on feelings, hygiene, food, activity and safety.

days.title: Teach someone
days.work: Teach a family member a health skill.

days.title: Healthy party
days.work: Plan and prepare a healthy snack party.

days.title: Celebrate
days.work: Present your book at the party.
